def: Japhia, the name of a Canaanite, an Israelite, and a place in Palestine

occurrences.text: Wherefore Adoni–zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,

And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
